text.tspan: Who Americans spend their time with All ages
Measured in hours per day, based on annual averages from surveys in the United States.

tspan.tspan: Activities such as sleeping, grooming, and personal care are not included in the data. Relationships used to categorize people are not

text.tspan: exhaustive and time spent with multiple people counts toward all (e.g., attending a party with friends and partner counts toward both "friends"
